name: row pass

name: clip swap
note: the entry writes the call's rect as an origin and an extent -- 0x44 = right - left, 0x48 = bottom - top -- for the length of the pass and puts the four values back afterwards, so the rect the style layer hands down is the rectangle every glyph below is tested against

name: glyph loop
note: cull if the glyph's right <= 0, the clip's extent < the glyph's X, its bottom <= 0 or the clip's lower extent < the glyph's Y; then trim the width to (extent - glyph)/scale and the height the same way

name: glyph pass
note: the pass calls 0x001036e0, which culls a glyph whose anchor is past the clip's right or bottom edge and trims one that runs past it

name: measure
note: the entry calls it first and moves the draw position by the width it answers; the alignment moves the text, the clip is the rect and is not re-derived from it

name: text entry
note: the styled draw's canvas virtual: copies the string, zeroes the cursor, swaps the clip for the call's rect, measures and draws through +0xa0/+0xa4, then restores the four clip floats

name: tile path
note: the body the glyph loop emits through has no float compare in it: its only early exits are two null checks and it scales the quad by the canvas's four scale floats, so a zero-width quad is submitted and simply covers nothing

name: styled-text callers

name: empty rect
note: the pass works in the clip's own frame: the entry zeroes the cursor, so the first glyph's advance is 0 and its X is 0 -- the anchor cull does not fire and the trim answers (0 - 0)/scale = 0, a quad of no width; every later glyph has X > 0 and is culled by the clip's extent, which is 0
